    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('week', revenue_date) AS week_start,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.dws_daily_revenue
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    week_start,
    total_revenue
FROM weekly_rev
ORDER BY week_start DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH weekly_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('week', revenue_date) AS week_start,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.dws_daily_revenue
    GROUP BY 1
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        week_start,
        total_revenue,
        LAG(total_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY week_start) AS prev_revenue
    FROM weekly_rev
)
SELECT 
    week_start,
    total_revenue,
    prev_revenue,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_revenue IS NULL OR prev_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND((total_revenue - prev_revenue) / prev_revenue * 100, 2)
    END AS growth_pct
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY week_start DESC

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('week', revenue_date) AS week_start,
    MIN(revenue_date) AS min_date,
    MAX(revenue_date) AS max_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT revenue_date) AS days_count,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.dws_daily_revenue
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY week_start DESC
